cue.heading: Wood v. Milyard (2012)
cue.before: We note here the distinction between defenses that are “waived” and those that are “forfeited.”
cue.quote: A waived claim or defense is one that a party has <mark>knowingly and intelligently relinquished</mark>; a forfeited plea is one that a party has <mark>merely failed to preserve</mark>.
